extracted text: The material used in this study was AlMg5Si2Mn HPDC alloy. The study compares different processing methods: PA treatment (homogenization at 580°C for 24h) and PB treatment (3% cold rolling followed by homogenization at 580°C for 24h). The PB treatment led to better hot workability by disintegrating interconnected Mg2Si phases. T4 treatment involved solution treatment at 580°C for 1h followed by water quenching. T6 treatment involved additional aging at 250°C for 1h after T4 treatment.
